_about: How well an employer pays an IIT graduate, in four tiers, used to rank competitions after IIT-only ones.
Tier 1 is where IIT placements pay most: quant and trading firms, investment banks, top strategy consulting, big tech.
Tier 3 is big companies that hire in volume and pay an IITian less (Tata, ITC, Reliance, FMCG, IT services, Big Four).
These are rough groupings by employer type, not salary data. Move a company by editing its pattern; first match wins, tier 1 is tried first.
Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the organiser's name, and against the title and prize text for a sponsor.
